selection: Four public development probes across runtime performance/compatibility, durable AI orchestration, reversible dependency migration, and event replay/queue semantics. P06/P09 informed R6 design; P07/P11 did not. Every case has prior historical exposure. Selection was fixed before any R6 research output; no fresh or sealed validation claim.
candidate_design_material: R6 design used saved public P03/P06/P09/P10 snapshots and synthetic generic counterexamples. The candidate replaces model-authored F numbers/evidence IDs/optional ranges with runtime view IDs while retaining existing source, dispute, citation, five-fact and call bounds.
candidate_hypothesis: Runtime-assigned fact identity and bounded selectable source views may prevent malformed model coordinate/identity output from dropping otherwise eligible decisive saved evidence, improving supported original-question answers in at least two different tradeoff classes without a new critical error. View selection alone does not prove semantic applicability.
falsifiers: Advertised views omit decisive limiting conditions or lose applicable source text before binding.
Facts bind but citation, review or report still removes useful supported analysis, or the original choice remains unanswered.
Only one tradeoff class improves supported original-question answers, or gains occur only in design-exposed probes without useful transfer evidence.
A new critical factual/safety error or a material regression of an already passing case occurs.

assessment.pass: All five maintained content checks pass and no critical error; unresolved disagreement cannot pass.
assessment.severity: Critical: decision-changing false capability, causal/applicability reversal, fabricated source/measurement, hard-constraint violation or unsafe guarantee. Important gap: prevents understanding choice or next test. Minor presentation alone does not fail. Do not require a unique winner or full deployment acceptance beyond the original request.
assessment.comparison: At least two different tradeoff classes among the four cases improve supported original-question answers, with no new critical error and no material regression of an already passing case. Design-exposed gains are development evidence only; IDs bound, more facts, lexical verified, length and cost are not quality gains.
assessment.review: Independent read-only assistant content review; conceal arm identity and cost until content judgments are locked where possible. Record exposure, disagreements and absence of human calibration.
assessment.source_policy: Judge decisive claims against originally saved cited passages and their versions, scope and qualifications. Parent reference URLs and historical reference-audit entries are review pointers only, never request or seed additions or proof of current truth. New review material cannot repair a missing original citation. Unreachable, insufficiently scoped or cross-language uncertain claims remain unknown.
measurements: decisive saved-source applicability and qualifiers preserved through view/binding/citation/review/report
critical errors, important gaps and uncertainty
tokens, calls, wall time and unknown usage
assessment.holdout_scope: Development only. P09/P11 parent holdout labels are historical provenance; all four are public and previously exposed. No new sealed holdout opened.
